statement: For n≥2k−1, the matrix-entry degree of the Stiefel variety St(k,n) is 2^(k(k+1)/2).
scope: Integers 1<=k<=n and n>=2k-1, within the parameters of the existing family.
notes: If n>=2k-1, the matrix-entry degree of St(k,n) is 2^(k(k+1)/2), since its projective closure is a complete intersection of k(k+1)/2 quadrics.
